_about: Tome's first-week list (Goals, scripts/items/goals.gd; README.md, Goals): small goals for a new farm, so the first days are not only water and wait. goals: in the order the HUD shows them; each {id, text (shown on the HUD with the progress), stat, count, reward, say}. stat is what is counted (Game.goal_stats): planted (field plots with a crop now), talked (villagers ever talked to), forage (wild things picked), fish (fish caught), crops_shipped (crops ever shipped), earned (G the shipping cart has paid). Every goal counts from the first morning, whichever the HUD shows: one done early pays out as soon as it is done. reward: money (G), items {id: how many} into the rucksack (what doesn't fit goes in the storage chest), animal (a kind, young: true for a chick, animal_name for the message; if the home is full, animal_money instead). say: where in data/dialogue the list's note for it starts ({dialogue, at}): the farmer ticks the line and reads the thank-you a villager wrote under it, shown once nothing else holds the screen (no menu, text box or event). messages: the HUD and message-line texts (%s / %d as in each). Balance (ours, see WORKLOG 2026-11-03 Week-one goals): the 500 G start buys about six turnip bags; the list adds about 2,300 G of value over the first week (270 G cash, 180 G of rice balls, 480 G of seed bags, the chick), more than half of it as the chick at the end (a hen is 1,400 G at the store), so the first animal comes in week one and not week three. The early ones (plant, say hello, pick wild things) are a day's walk each; ship 5 crops waits for the first turnips (day 5); earn 1,000 G is about day 7 with the field, forage and a few fish.
